channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ivica Zubac | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ivica Zubac from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on Ivica Zubac:

“Obviously, he is such a big guy, poses a lot of different threats offensively and defensively, rebounding the basketball, outlets, all those things. We’re just starting our connection,but I’m really enjoying playing alongside him for the first week or whatever, and I’m looking forward to playing against other teams here soon.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Ivica Zubac, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Law Murray:Lawrence Frank on Ivica Zubac departure:

“It was a lot of tears shed, but all of us.... We didn't want to trade him. But if there's an offer that's just too good to say no to, that just enhances our future, we're gonna have to seriously think about it.”

Lawrence Frank on Ivica Zubac, Feb 9, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
‪Justin Russo‬:Kawhi Leonard, on his emotions finding out Ivica Zubac was traded:

“It’s almost like losing a brother. We see these people, the players around here more than we see our families, in a sense, during the NBA season. … He’s a face that we’re gonna miss in the locker [room].”

Kawhi Leonard on Ivica Zubac, Feb 7, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Clippers President Lawrence Frank on trading Ivica Zubac:

“Zu is one of the best centers in the NBA, the longest-tenured player on the team and a pillar of everything we’ve done for the past seven years. He is an elite rim protector and rebounder who made himself into an effective offensive threat, a tribute to his hard work. We will miss Zu as a player and a person.”

Lawrence Frank on Ivica Zubac, Feb 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Zach Edey on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Zach Edey on Ivica Zubac:

“Always someone I looked at -- like, yeah, I could kind of do a lot of what he does in the league.”

Zach Edey on Ivica Zubac, Nov 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on James Harden, Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Tyronn Lue:

“We don’t have a lot of point-of-attack offensive guys that can create their own shots, so we rely on James [Harden], we rely on [Ivica Zubac] to make those guys better and get those guys open shots. The other guys gotta step up and shoot them with confidence.”

Tyronn Lue on James Harden, Ivica Zubac, Nov 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Brook Lopez on Ivica Zubac:

“I think that we complement each other very well… he's become such a great player. Absolutely a candidate for DPOY this year. And he still has even more room to grow, which is just scary to think.”

Brook Lopez on Ivica Zubac, Oct 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Adelman said when asked if he thinks Jokic should’ve shot more 3s.

“Aaron’s playing behind the defense. It creates corner 3s. Things like that. But probably (want to) have a better mix on Saturday. Let that thing fly a little bit, especially when Zubac is down the floor. “You know Nikola. Everything he does is trying to be the most unselfish player he can be. Saturday, maybe we need a little more selfishness from the 3-point line.”

David Adelman on Nikola Jokic, Ivica Zubac, May 2, 2025. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: David Adelman on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
“It’s a good conversation. … I think he felt, driving the close-outs with Zubac, if he gets by him, he’s creating offense for other people,”

David Adelman on Ivica Zubac, May 2, 2025. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Nikola Jokic on Ivica Zubac:

“I've played against him a lot and for a long period of time. I think he's really improving. I think he was kind of one-dimensional before. But now he can post up. He can pass it from the pocket. They are looking for him. He is really evolving his game.”

Nikola Jokic on Ivica Zubac, Apr 18, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on Ivica Zubac All-Star case:

“Just keep doing what he's doing... he's been great for us. That's all that really matters.”

Tyronn Lue on Ivica Zubac, Dec 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul George, Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Mike Malone with faux shock in response to being told Kawhi will play today:

“Anticipated Kawhi being back, Paul George is an amazing talent, Zubac is one of the more underrated players ... I really respect his game.”

Michael Malone on Paul George, Ivica Zubac, May 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Serena Winters:D’Angelo Russell on Ivica Zubac:

“When he gets his opportunity, he’s going to be special…He’s really smart & he really works.”

D'Angelo Russell on Ivica Zubac, Jan 30, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Nick Young on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Nick Young:

“Zubac has been great, I saw it this summer. When I came back, I was like who is this guy?”

Nick Young on Ivica Zubac, Jan 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Serena Winters:Luke Walton on Ivica Zubac:

“We all think he’s going to be a big part of our franchise in the future…we’re all fascinated w/ what he can be”

Luke Walton on Ivica Zubac, Jan 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Anthony Brown on Ivica Zubac
item.description:
Serena Winters:Anthony Brown:

“That boy (Ivica) Zubac, he definitely impressed me. I’m still trying to figure out how he went second round.”

Anthony Brown on Ivica Zubac, Jul 16, 2016. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.
